material_findings.title: Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026
material_findings.confidence: high for official sponsor rules and prize schedule; participant eligibility and build readiness unknown
material_findings.prize_evidence: Official rules enumerate 20 cash prizes totalling up to $1,000,000: Entertainment and Gaming each have two $100k winners and two $50k runners-up; Productivity has two $70k winners and two $35k runners-up; six special awards at $25k; two Judges Choice awards at $20k. Best Agentic Interaction is a $25k special award. These are competitive conditional prizes, not guaranteed income.
material_findings.eligibility: Adults 18+ in eligible regions; excludes Brazil, Quebec, sanctioned areas and other restricted parties; Meta account with Developer Access and a Meta VR Start member representative required by submission. Individual, team or organization entries permitted; project must not have Meta development funding.
material_findings.entry_cost: No purchase necessary per official rules. Internet, developer access, membership, toolchain/hosting and any participant hardware/software costs are the entrant's responsibility; no Quest headset required per official FAQ.
material_findings.authorization: Only authorizes original competition submissions on approved build paths, not security testing or production probing.
material_findings.requirements: Hands-first experience end-to-end for Quest 3/3S. New or significantly updated experience built during eligible window; choose Gaming/Entertainment/Productivity track and new/adapted division. Native APK via Competition release channel or IWSDK/WebXR hosted link (including GitHub Pages). Public YouTube/Vimeo demonstration under three minutes, text description and Devpost submission required.
missing_verification: Confirm real participant account with Developer Access, VR Start acceptance and Devpost registration; none verified.
Check access to an emulator/WebXR/IWSDK, ability to run and capture hands-only Quest 3/3S experience, and availability of hosting/video upload.
Select new vs significantly updated division; verify project provenance, license of all assets, and absence of Meta-funded development.
Check entrant-specific jurisdiction, payment, tax and compliance terms before spending development effort.
material_findings.next_action: Build/integration agent: verify account/program and WebXR feasibility first; if gates clear, scope a small original hands-first experience (possibly agentic interaction) for Nov 18, otherwise keep triage.
